description: This file implements the setup, teardown, and initialization functions for a 6to4 IPv6 tunneling protocol in OpenWrt, handling IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnels including configuration validation, prefix calculation, and routing setup.

methods.name: find_6to4_prefix
methods.description: Calculates the 6to4 IPv6 prefix from an IPv4 address.

methods.name: test_6to4_rfc1918
methods.description: Tests whether an IPv4 address is in a private or special range based on RFC 1918 and RFC 6598.

methods.name: proto_6to4_setup
methods.description: Sets up IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel configuration based on provided parameters.

methods.name: proto_6to4_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder for tearing down a 6to4 tunnel (currently empty).

methods.name: proto_6to4_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the 6to4 protocol.
